title: Pilot: limited sharing
body_lines: During this pilot, your connection is only used to reach a short list of test sites.
Requests to anything else are blocked on this device before they leave.
You can pause sharing at any time.
rules: Show after P2 and before the first dial, only when public egress is switched on
Do not list or name the test sites in copy
Not shown when egress is off (default Alpha-3 behavior)
